title: Hatred
description: An expanding minecraft zombie datapack, trying to build a feeling of actual realistic zombie apocalypse versus the player. Including custom structure, weapons, ...
body:
![ ](https://i.postimg.cc/4NkVHKsc/minecraft-title.png)
# **Introduction**
Hatred's goal is to try to give your world a touch of what you'd expect in a zombie apocalyptic survival enviroment while still retaining many feats of Minecraft's originality. Be expecting many more features to come as implementing them can be time comsuming.

You get to play Minecraft as usual in Hatred, however all common overworld hostile mobs are exclusively zombies, very strong zombies. One moment of carelessness will put you down quicker than you'd imagine, and things only get worse at night. Gear up to prepare for the stronger zombie day scaling kicks in.

### Zombie design:
- Faster and stronger, better vision and bigger numbers.
- Climb up to 6 blocks.
- Zombie variants in job and size
- drop unique items upon death some depend on their employment.
- doesn't break block or place block yet (in development)
- sound alert system (In development)

### Pillagers:
- Have guns, stronger faster and better sight.
- Beef with the undeads.

## Key features:
- Augmented zombies, scaling up to 60 days.
- Augmented pillagers, iron golems and wolves.
- Remove spiders, skeletons and creepers entirely in overworld.
- Very customizable with Setting given at first load.
- Custom loots, textures and weapons.
- Air drop system, flare gun.
- Event system (rework in-development).
- Custom crafting recipes.
- Skill tree for permanent stat-upgrades (rework in-development).
- Radio for calling various military protocols.
- Custom structure.
- Custom mechanisms, see it in-game for yourself.
### ! difficulty heavily dictates zombie's stats, adjust to easy if you find Hatred overwhelming !

<summary>Best custom commands</summary>

Require allow command if you don't have the Setting item.

lost your Setting item ?
- /function hatred:admin/setting_item

custom zombie spawn quantity, for either reduce lag or for apocalyptic feeling, best paired with a mob spawn cap remover mod.
- /function hatred:cmd/spawn_less_zombie
- /function hatred:cmd/spawn_normal_zombie
- /function hatred:cmd/spawn_many_zombie
- /function hatred:cmd/spawn_apocalypse

looking for a difficulty beyond hard?
- /function hatred:cmd/expert_mode_on
- /function hatred:cmd/expert_mode_off

supply drop rate, some just couldn't wait for it innit ?
- /function hatred:cmd/supply_drop_every_4_nights
- /function hatred:cmd/supply_drop_every_3_nights
- /function hatred:cmd/supply_drop_every_2_nights
- /function hatred:cmd/supply_drop_every_nights

having FPS issue ? just remove their armor, 10x FPS even at large zombie.
- /function hatred:cmd/zombie_variant_no_armor
- /function hatred:cmd/zombie_variant_on

</details>
